title: [Bug] The github bot creates impenetrable webs of duplicate tags in bug reports -- all of which will be closed in 3 days.
body:
**Bug Description**
The github bot creates impenetrable webs of duplicates in bug reports -- all of which will be "closed in 3 days".  Often, the guessed duplicates are different problems.  As a result, real bugs will automatically closed.

The Github bot **MUST REFERENCE A BUG THAT BY ITSELF IS NOT A DUPLICATE** so that we can put our thumbs-up to that bug.  **DO NOT LINK TO BUGS THAT ARE MARKED AS DUPLICATES FOR DELETION**.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: vte-based
- Version: 2.1.12
- Feedback ID: 7c40a84f-f6de-4b34-a920-79d83007b13e

**Errors**
```json
[]
```
author: Yaakov-Belch

top_comments.body: An update about this problem. The bot is now closing issues as duplicates, despite downvoting the initial bot "To prevent auto-closure, add a comment or 👎 this comment", see example https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/18813#issuecomment-3777582316
